fusions.name: Unhurried Settle
fusions.desc: A press of the trowel that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Wake
fusions.desc: Rolls a wave of slurry at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Mend
fusions.desc: Heals you and every ally within 4 tiles for 14 health, plus 1% more for each 1% of your cast speed.

fusions.name: Slow to Bruise
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
